MACD 히스토그램은 -12.6747로 악화 지속. 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일한 645.66으로 Higher Low 패턴 미확인. 주봉 RSI 50.4로 중립 구간. ADX 27.9로 추세는 뚜렷하나 -DI가 +DI보다 우위. 현재가 $645.83은 SMA100($629.92) 및 SMA200($631.67) 상회하나 EMA200($643.14) 하회. 스윙 지지선 $638.61에 근접. 52주 저가 $520.26 대비 23.8% 상단. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 1.29배로 증가. 정량 매수 매력도 70점. 4시간봉 RSI 28.2로 과매도. 종합적으로 과매도 구간 진입 및 CCI 극단 반등 신호, 거래량 증가, 정량 매수 점수 70점 고려 시 매수 진입. 다만 MACD 악화 및 ADX 추세 강도 유지 고려 시 추가 하락 가능성 상존.
analysis.reasonEn: After entering a buy on the previous judgment (2026-10-22), a -7.41% drop brought the stop loss close. RSI slightly decreased from 37.4 to 36.4 but remains in oversold territory. CCI entered extreme oversold at -273.2. MACD histogram continued to worsen at -12.6747. The 5-day low and 20-day low are identical at 645.66, failing to confirm a Higher Low pattern. Weekly RSI is at 50.4, in neutral territory. ADX is 27.9, indicating a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI. The current price of $645.83 is above SMA100 ($629.92) and SMA200 ($631.67) but below EMA200 ($643.14). It is approaching the swing support at $638.61. This is 23.8% above the 52-week low of $520.26. Volume ratio is 1.29 times the 5-day average, indicating an increase. Quantitative buy attractiveness is 70 points. The 4-hour RSI is 28.2, in oversold territory. Considering the oversold entry, extreme CCI rebound signal, increased volume, and a quantitative buy score of 70, a buy entry is initiated. However, given the MACD worsening and sustained ADX trend strength, further downside risk remains.
